faq.question: How much does double glazing cost?
faq.answer: As a guide based on typical UK market rates, a standard casement window runs from around £350 to £900 installed, sash windows from around £600 to £1,100, and bay windows from around £1,200 to £3,200 depending on size - prices vary by region and specification. Compare free quotes to get an exact figure for your property.

faq.question: Is this service really free?
faq.answer: CONFIRM YOUR REAL FUNDING MODEL BEFORE PUBLISHING. As a guide, comparison services like this are typically free for homeowners, funded instead by a referral fee paid by installers when they receive a quote request - which keeps quotes unbiased since there's no incentive to push one installer over another.

faq.question: Are your installers FENSA registered?
faq.answer: CONFIRM YOUR REAL VETTING CRITERIA BEFORE PUBLISHING - do not claim FENSA registration for installers in your network unless verified. As a guide, most reputable comparison services only accept FENSA-registered installers into their network.
